relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - closest fit among registry predicates for 'this SDK targets both Capella and self-managed Server transparently', though the fit is imperfect - flagged in cross_product_finding rather than asserted confidently as the ideal predicate
relations.evidence: The Couchbase Java SDK allows Java applications to access a Couchbase cluster — Capella or self-managed.

notable_absence.finding: This is the top-level 'Couchbase Java SDK 3.12' landing page: install snippet, three teaser code samples (KV upsert with durability, a parametrized SQL++ query, a vector search request), a list of ecosystem integrations (Spring Data, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Spark Connector), and two large link-listing sections ('Using Your Database', 'Resources'). Every technical term it touches (DurabilityLevel.MAJORITY, cluster.query, VectorSearch/VectorQuery) is already covered by dedicated howto pages elsewhere in this round's batches, so this page contributes no new concept - purely a navigation and marketing hub. concepts[] is correctly empty.

cross_component_finding: The teaser code block here (`collection.upsert("my-document", JsonObject.create().put("doc", true), upsertOptions().durability(DurabilityLevel.MAJORITY));`) is character-for-character identical to the one repeated in start-using-sdk.md, confirming both pages intentionally share the same canonical first example rather than drifting into inconsistent variants.
cross_product_finding: The 'Analytics SDKs' tip box draws an explicit product-boundary distinction this batch has not seen stated so directly elsewhere: Enterprise Analytics (RT-OLAP) and Capella Analytics (Columnar) 'need different SDKs' because Capella Analytics 'does not have Enterprise Analytics' load balancer, and uses a different connection protocol' - i.e., even though both are called '(Enterprise/Capella) Analytics', they are NOT interchangeable at the SDK connection layer despite sharing a name, a same-name-different-product-surface pattern consistent with several other collisions already documented elsewhere in this registry (e.g., role:full-administrator's writeup, analytics:workbench vs capella:analytics-workbench).
